purpose: Order 104 generic hypothesis 2/3: make filesystem.find results explicitly route Writer document paths to document.read_file and discourage rereading an already-read path.

When returned files include DOC, DOCX, ODT, or RTF, suggest document.read_file and tell the model to read each distinct relevant returned path once. The result preserves returned paths and does not select a path, track task identity, derive document contents, mutate files, or consult golden/evaluator state.
